data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display photos and widgets in full screen with vertical scroll dismiss.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FullScreenWidget wrapper that enlarges child widgets or photos into a full-screen view. It supports Hero animations, custom background colors, transparency toggles, and automatically dismisses when scrolled vertically.
use_when: You want to let users tap an image to view it in full screen.
You need smooth Hero transitions between regular and full-screen image states.
You want quick full-screen capabilities with minimal boilerplate.
avoid_when: You need complex pinch-to-zoom, pan, or multi-image gallery swiping.
You require advanced image caching or custom provider loading strategies.
strengths: Extremely easy to set up with a single wrapper widget.
Supports custom backgrounds and non-transparent views.
Works seamlessly out of the box with Flutter's Hero widget.
weaknesses: Lacks advanced photo viewer features like pinch-to-zoom.
No built-in gallery swiping between multiple images.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose photo_view if you need advanced features like pinch-to-zoom, panning, and multi-image galleries.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose cached_network_image if you primarily need to load, cache, and display network images rather than just full-screen toggling.
